flips: UT-01 (Salt Lake City & West Valley City)

summaries.senate: Polymarket odds put the Democrats in the favoured position for Senate control, with a slight gain in their chances today. The Democrat in [[Kansas]], Adam Hamilton, gained ground sharply and is now a predicted flip, while the Democrat in [[Maine]], Troy Jackson, also moved up by a moderate amount in another predicted flip. Over in [[Florida]], the chances of the Republican Ashley Moody slipped by a sizable amount.
summaries.governor: The biggest move came in [[Vermont]], where the Republican Phil Scott's chances took a sharp drop in the Polymarket odds. In [[Texas]], the Republican Greg Abbott also slipped by a sizable margin. In [[New Hampshire]], the market shows a moderate decline for the Republican Kelly Ayotte.
summaries.house: The Polymarket projected House count recently changed to 240-195, up from 239-196, which would mean Democrats gain control. The biggest move came in [[TX-23 (Del Rio & Eagle Pass)]], where the Democrat Katy Padilla Stout's chances rose sharply against the Republican Brandon Herrera. In [[NY-17 (Spring Valley & Ossining)]], a predicted flip, the Democrat Cait Conley edged up slightly in the market's view.
